package.name: so101_hardware_interface
package.description:
Bridges the real SO-101 Feetech servo bus to ROS 2 by wrapping LeRobot's SOFollower driver. Subscribes /joint_cmd_safe (so101_msgs/JointCommand, velocities rad/s), integrates a position setpoint per joint, and drives the arm via SOFollower.send_action(). Publishes /joint_states (sensor_msgs/JointState, radians) from SOFollower.get_observation(). Degree<->radian conversion lives here only -- no other node in the stack should touch degrees.
This is a deliberate deviation from the design doc's "C++ for control-critical nodes" guidance: LeRobot's SOFollower driver is Python-only, and the user has an already-working, calibrated SOFollower setup, so wrapping it directly in rclpy avoids reimplementing a Feetech bus driver in C++ or bridging via pybind.
